heading: Today
text: Morning rain. Windy, mild, scattered afternoon showers.

heading: Friday Night
text: Scattered showers, changing to a little snow north and mountains. Colder.

heading: Saturday
text: A few morning flurries north and mountains. Blustery, increasing sun, quite cold.
temperature: Mid 30s to mid 40s, north to south

heading: Sunday
temperature: Low to mid 50s, some upper 40s northeast
